profit_quality.assessment: The school business converts accounting profit into cash well in 2022-2023 because tuition and boarding fees are prepaid. However, part of the cash flow comes from contract-liability growth, while the buyer cannot freely distribute prepaid service cash. The denominator therefore starts from normalised parent-share operating cash profit rather than reported group profit.
adjustments: Started from 2023 group profit before tax and removed interest income and government grant release as non-school operating earnings.
Added back the one-off Jingyi Secondary School conversion cost disclosed in the core net profit bridge.
Applied the 2023 parent profit attribution ratio to avoid treating minority-interest profit as listed-shareholder cash profit.
Used RMB350m as the pre-haircut sustainable distributable cash profit, below the 2023 parent net profit of RMB388.196m.
Applied a 0.65 profit haircut for PRC private education/VIE extraction limits, development fund requirements, and the fact that detailed cash-flow validation is only two years in this fact pack.
profit_quality.cashflow_support: 2023 operating cash flow was RMB733.744m and 2022 operating cash flow was RMB643.539m, both above reported profit; 2023 capex was RMB76.542m and 2022 capex was RMB182.685m.
profit_quality.haircut_reason: Stable cash conversion supports a positive denominator, but education regulation, VIE structure, prepaid cash obligations, minority interests and incomplete three-year cash-flow extraction require a material haircut.
profit_quality.cash_conversion_assessment: Good on reported CFO/FCF, but some cash flow is advance tuition and cannot be treated as distributable.
profit_quality.maintenance_capex_assessment: 2023 capex of RMB76.542m is used as the latest maintenance-plus-normal-campus spending reference; 2022 was higher at RMB182.685m due to heavier campus investment.
profit_quality.working_capital_assessment: 2023 working-capital movement was cash-releasing, including contract liabilities increasing RMB85.546m and other payables increasing RMB62.479m; this should not be extrapolated as distributable cash.
